title: Container With Most Water

content.problemStatement:
You are given an integer array `height` of length `n`. There are `n` vertical lines drawn such that the two endpoints of the `i`-th line are `(i, 0)` and `(i, height[i])`.

Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container, such that the container contains the most water.

Return the maximum amount of water a container can store.

Notice that you may not slant the container.
content.inputFormat: An array of integers representing heights.
content.outputFormat: An integer representing the maximum water container capacity.

sampleTestCases.explanation: The above vertical lines are represented by array [1,8,6,2,5,4,8,3,7]. In this case, the max area of water the container can contain is 49.
The two lines of height 1 at indices 0 and 1 form a container of area 1 * 1 = 1.

solution.approach: Use two pointers starting at both ends of the array. The area formed is limited by the shorter line: (right - left) * min(height[left], height[right]). To potentially find a larger area, advance the pointer at the shorter line inward. Repeat until the pointers meet.
